mutations.from:
IF parent = "Exhausted" \/ nested = "Exhausted"
    THEN "Exhausted"
    ELSE IF parent = "Matched" \/ nested = "Matched"
         THEN "Matched"
mutations.to:
IF parent = "Matched" \/ nested = "Matched"
    THEN "Matched"
    ELSE IF parent = "Exhausted" \/ nested = "Exhausted"
         THEN "Exhausted"
